dex.entry: Glostern's kindled form — its bell has expanded enormously and its moon-glow fills the surrounding sea. A moving constellation-lantern. The biggest visual surprise on the southern coast — seeing one rise out of the harbour is awe-inspiring.

art.silhouette: Vast translucent bell filled with golden light that fractures like stained glass, eight long trailing tentacles tipped with bright orbs like low-hanging stars. Deep navy outer bell, blazing gold interior.
